sloka: हुत्वा चैव अग्निहोत्राणि प्राश्य च अमृतवत् हविः ।विविशुर् जाह्नवी तीरे शुभा मुदित मानसाः ॥१-३५-१०॥
transliteration: hutvā caiva agnihotrāṇi prāśya ca amṛtavat haviḥ ।viviśur jāhnavī tīre śubhā mudita mānasāḥ ॥1-35-10॥

translations.english: The birds had made the bank of the river their home. They (Rama and Lakshmana) took a dip and offered traditional oblations to ancestors. Thereafter they lighted the sacrificial fire and made customary offerings to the fire and partook of the nectarlike remains. With cheerful hearts they stood round the illustrious Viswamitra and entered the sacred bank of Jahnavi.
translations.hindi: अपने सव मंत्रियों को बुला कर, उनसे यह सलाह की कि, उन राजकन्याओं का विवाह अच्छे देशकाल व घर में किया जाय
